title: Icelandic Phallological Museum
limitations: The museum occupies the glass corner of a shared retail and office building. The model covers the exterior of its occupied block, including the surrounding storefronts and stepped office terraces.
The exterior and doorway are aligned to PMTiles and photographs. Window fittings, signs and roof services are approximations. The exhibit interior is outside the model scope.

The building follows the host terrain at the museum point. The standard Terrarium sample at this waterfront has a substantial vertical offset from the visible coastline, so it serves as a local grade reference.
